_comment: Declarative registry for ghidractl. A 'workspace' = one Ghidra project = one generic pyghidra-mcp server = one port = one .mcp.json entry. Multiple binaries can live in one workspace (routed by binary_name). ghidractl itself is generic and vendor-agnostic — it only reads this file. Ported from godzilla-decomp 2026-07-29. Ports 8021-8023 belong to godzilla-decomp; halo uses 8031+.

halo.desc: Halo CE build 2342 match target: cachebeta.exe (Win32 i386 PE, MSVC vc7 13.00.9254, ImageBase 0x400000, 6.5MB) plus the three companion XBEs

binaries.label: cachebeta
binaries.arch: i386 Win32 PE — ImageBase 0x00400000, linker 7.00, built 2002-01-14
binaries._note: THE match target. csplit slices this into build/split/**.obj, which objdiff scores candidates against. sha256 4cc87b45f721270392a96f1674ed2b5cd4a7bb4355faeab4531d1cf1884d9520. A stripped cachebeta.pdb ships beside it in ../halo-protos/ce_2002-01-14/ — type NAMES only, all struct bodies empty, so it is near-useless for member layout; use the CEA workspace for that.

binaries.label: cachebeta_xbe
binaries._note: Xbox-side executable from the same Jan 14 2002 package. Ghidra 12.1.2 has NO XBE loader, so this does NOT import — verified 2026-07-29, the project contains only cachebeta.exe. Left registered as documentation of intent; to actually load it, install an XBE loader extension or import the raw image manually at the XBE base address.

cea.desc: Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary (Jun 24 2011, cl 0.0.83147) reference build — Xbox 360 XEX2 with FULL private PDBs. The symbol source the decomp's README points at.

binaries.label: hcex
binaries.arch: Xbox 360 XEX2 (PowerPC BE), preferred load address 0x82000000
binaries._note: Debug config. Pair with HCEX.pdb — pdb-decompiler recovers 10,146 source files whose tree mirrors ALL 38 of this decomp's source/ directories. Extracted output: ../halo-symbols/cea_2011-06-24_HCEX/

binaries.label: hcex_release
binaries.arch: Xbox 360 XEX2 (PowerPC BE), preferred load address 0x82000000

cea._pdb_note: IMPORTANT: PDB completeness varies BY BUILD, not by config. Jun 24 2011 carries module->source-file mappings (10,146 files recovered). Jul 28 2011 does NOT — same 124MB size, but pdb-decompiler emits only exported.h. Always probe a PDB before trusting it; see ../halo-symbols/README.md.
